# dsh-music-panel
A NetEase Cloud Music (网易云音乐) panel plugin for **DeepSeek Harness** — search, charts, favorites, pla
y history, lyrics and taste-based recommendations inside the DSH desktop web UI. **Official streams
only: it never unlocks VIP or region-locked tracks.**
*Searching "晴天" — results come straight from the official NetEase Cloud Music API.*
*Hot chart — official stream, 200 tracks.*
*Now playing: official direct stream (320k) with scrolling lyrics and credits. No unlock, no third-p
official direct stream (320k) with scrolling lyrics and credits. No unlock, no third-party source.*
> 中文说明见下方 中文。
## What it is
`dsh-music-panel` adds a full music panel to DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry opens a Magpie-style
page with search, charts, your favorites and play history, synced lyrics, and a recommendation feed
built from your own listening profile. Audio is streamed through the plugin's own host routes, so th
e browser never talks to a third-party CDN directly.
Everything the plugin can play comes from the **official NetEase Cloud Music API**. If the official
API refuses to hand out a playable URL for a track, the panel says so and stops there.

tes, stored locally |
| Play history | Play / skip / completion tracking, last 600 entries |

s | Synced (LRC) plus translation lines when available |
| Taste profile | Weighted profile from fav

orites, plays and tags with time decay |
| Recommendations | Tag-based and profile-based discovery;

optional Last.fm similarity |

milarity |

## Playback policy (please read)
- The plugin **does not unlock VIP tracks, paid albums, or region-restricted tracks**. It contains n
o third-party audio sources, no proxy tricks, no certificate handling and no external helper process

rty audio sources, no proxy tricks, no certificate handling and no external helper process.

## Install
This is a local (`file:`) DSH plugin — it is not on npm.
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility
- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x**, desktop app, **web** frontend (`dsh.client.platform = "web"`, loads im

mediately).
- Node.js **≥ 20** on the host side (uses global `fetch`, `AbortSignal.timeout`, `Readab

le.fromWeb`).
- No runtime npm dependencies.
- Host routes are registered through `ctx.webServer.reg
ister({ kind: 'exact', … })`; the client bundle registers through `window.__ModuleLoader__`.
## Privacy

- **No telemetry, no analytics, no author-side server.** Nothing is sent to the plugin author.
- Req
uests go directly from your machine to `music.163.com` (and to `ws.audioscrobbler.com` only if you c

onfigure a Last.fm key).
- Favorites, play history, tags and search history are stored **locally** i
n `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-music-data/library.json`. Nothing is uploaded, and deleting that file resets the p

anel.
- UI preferences (volume, view mode, last search) live in the browser's `localStorage`.
- Cove
r images are proxied only for `*.126.net` / `*.163.com` hosts; arbitrary URLs are rejected.
## Known limitations

- **VIP / paid / region-locked tracks do not play.** This is by design.
- Anonymous mode (no `cookie
`) gets noticeably worse search results: NetEase tends to bury VIP originals, and some official URLs
come back empty. With your own cookie the results and direct links are closer to the web player. Ne

ither mode unlocks anything.
- `/dsh-netease/api/health` still reports search-endpoint cooldowns; Ne
tEase rate-limits its search API per path, and the plugin rotates across a host × path matrix with e

xponential backoff.
- Lyrics and cover art depend entirely on what the official APIs return; some tr

acks have neither.
- The panel is a single page in the `main` slot; there is no standalone web build

cks have neither.
- The panel is a single page in the `main` slot; there is no standalone web build.
## 功能
| 功能 | 说明 |

| 搜索 | 歌曲 / 歌手，附歌手胶囊，可直达歌手页拿到被压掉的原唱 |
| 榜单 | 热歌 / 新歌 / 飙升 / 原创，也支持任意歌单 id |
| 收藏 | 单曲收藏，本地落盘 |
| 播放历

史 | 播放 / 跳过 / 听完状态，最多保留 600 条 |
| 歌词 | 逐行 LRC，有翻译时同屏显示 |
| 口味画像 | 按收藏、播放次数、标签加权，带时间衰减 |
| 推荐 | 标签推荐

+ 画像推荐，可选 Last.fm 相似歌手 |
| 播放器 | 浮动迷你播放器、队列、随机 / 循环、官方直链下载 |
## 兼容性

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x**，桌面端，**Web** 前端（`dsh.client.platform = "web"`，随启动立即加载）。
- 宿主侧 Node.js **

≥ 20**（用到全局 `fetch`、`AbortSignal.timeout`、`Readable.fromWeb`）。
- 无运行时 npm 依赖。
- 宿主路由走 `ctx.webServer
.register({ kind: 'exact', … })`；客户端 bundle 走 `window.__ModuleLoader__`。
## 隐私

- **无遥测、无统计、无作者服务端**，不会向插件作者发送任何数据。
- 请求从本机直连 `music.163.com`；只有你配置了 Last.fm key 时才会访问 `ws.audioscro

bbler.com`。
- 收藏、播放历史、标签、搜索历史**只存在本机** `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-music-data/library.json`，不上传；删掉该文件等于重置面板。
- 界

面偏好（音量、视图、上次搜索）存浏览器 `localStorage`。
- 封面只代理 `*.126.net` / `*.163.com` 的地址，其它域名一律拒绝。
## 已知限制

- **VIP / 付费 / 区域限制曲目不能播**，这是设计选择。
- 匿名模式（不配 `cookie`）搜索结果明显更差：网易云会压掉 VIP 原唱，部分官方直链也会返回空。配上自己的 Cooki

e 后接近网页播放器。两种模式都不会解锁任何东西。
- `/dsh-netease/api/health` 会报搜索接口冷却状态：网易云按路径限流，插件用「域名 × 路径」矩阵加指数退避轮换。
- 歌

词与封面完全取决于官方接口返回值，部分曲目两者都没有。
- 面板是 `main` 槽里的单页，没有独立 Web 构建。
